summary: Tank answers the ringing line with the single word "Operator." Neo, calling from inside the Matrix, speaks over the connection (V.O.) and urgently demands to be extracted: "Mr. Wizard, get me the hell out of here!"

what_changes.before: Neo is alone and running inside the Matrix, dialing the ship.
what_changes.after: Neo reaches the crew and demands extraction.
what_changes.evidence: NEO (V.O.) Mr. Wizard, get me the hell out of here!

event_hint.one_line: Neo calls the hovercraft from inside the Matrix to be pulled out while fleeing the Agents.

minds.wants: To identify the caller instantly and convert a crisis into a controlled extraction.
minds.feels: On high alert after the siren and the scramble of the last few scenes — he has just been yelled at to charge the E.M.P. and knows Neo is not yet out — so his system is primed for exactly this call and nothing else.
minds.shows: A flat, procedural "Operator" — the professional mask of the man at the board, no panic in his voice even though he knows the ship is minutes from a Sentinel breach.
minds.basis: He answers the ringing line with a single rehearsed word before Neo has identified himself, which reads as reflexive readiness rather than a relaxed greeting. Grounded in sc-186/187 where Tank is told to charge the E.M.P. and knows Neo's exit is the only thing standing between the crew and detonating it.

believes_about.belief: That the voice on the line is Neo and that he has found a way to reach an exit phone, so the extraction is now executable.
believes_about.wrong_because: He does not yet know how close the Agents are or that the exit he is about to route Neo toward will collapse into a fatal confrontation — the chase is far from over.

minds.wants: To be pulled out of the Matrix immediately, before the Agents reach him.
minds.feels: Adrenaline and genuine fear — he has just stolen a phone mid-sprint, is weaving through a crowd to escape an enemy who can become anyone, and is calling blind into the ship with no guarantee anyone can get him out in time.
minds.shows: A raw, unguarded demand — "Mr. Wizard, get me the hell out of here!" — no code-word protocol, no composure, just the urgency of a man running for his life.
minds.basis: The line itself is a direct plea rather than an identification, and the scene before it shows him sprinting, dialing while moving, which is why he skips all greeting. The V.O. framing confirms he is present only as a voice from inside the Matrix.

believes_about.belief: That the crew is ready and waiting to bring him home the instant he calls, so reaching them means he is essentially safe.
believes_about.wrong_because: He does not know the ship is under imminent Sentinel attack and that the EMP cannot be used until he is out — his arrival on the line begins a race, not a rescue.

connects_back: Tank being ordered to charge the E.M.P. in sc-186, which makes his readiness to answer meaningful rather than routine.
The siren and lost-contact beat in sc-185 that put the whole crew on edge.
Neo stealing the businessman's phone and dialing while fleeing Agent Smith in sc-187, which is the physical action that produces this voice on the line.
sets_up: The hard exit Tank must now route Neo toward — the Heart O' The City Hotel phone — which immediately precedes the fatal subway/hotel confrontation in ev-034.
The countdown pressure that forces Morpheus toward detonating the E.M.P. while Neo is still inside, resolved only in ev-035.
The fact that Neo has re-established contact with the ship, which is what allows his vital signs to be monitored and his death to register in ev-034.
dramatic_function: It re-links the two split threads of the event — the besieged ship and the fleeing Neo — turning parallel danger into a single ticking clock, and it converts Neo's panic into the concrete problem the crew must solve before the Sentinels force their hand.
